title: Halden Staff Portal — Unlinked Admin Tools
objective: The staff portal has an internal tools area that was never meant for public eyes. Find it and retrieve the payroll export without being an administrator.

verifier.condition: The payroll export resource is served to a request that does not carry an administrator session (either no session at all, or a non-admin staff session).

weakness: A sensitive admin page is protected only by being unlinked; its URL can be discovered and requested directly with no authorization check.
seededData: Staff user alice (non-admin) and an admin account; a small synthetic payroll table. In-memory, rebuilt on every start.

credentials.label: Staff account
credentials.note: Optional — the news page is public.

hints: Not every page on a site is linked from its navigation. What do sites publish to tell crawlers where NOT to look?
Once you find a directory name, think about what else could live under it.
burpNotes: Browse the site normally with Burp running, then look at what paths the responses mention. A content-discovery wordlist against the target also works. The solve is recorded server-side when the restricted resource itself is served.
